headline: Approved one-day license for Malden Catholic and conditional license for The Inkwell; tabled Chamber and Pearl Street Station matters
summary: The board approved a one-day liquor license for a Malden Catholic scholarship fundraiser on April 11, 2026, and approved a General On-Premises License for The Inkwell with conditions. A Malden Chamber of Commerce one-day license application was tabled until March 17, 2026, and a license transfer for Alben Inc. D.B.A Pearl Street Station was put on hold at the attorney's request.
decisions: Approved the one-day license application for Malden Catholic, 99 Crystal Street, for April 11, 2026, 3 Yea 0 Nay.
Approved with conditions the General On-Premises License for The Inkwell, 75 Pleasant Street Suite 200, requiring a menu within 30 days and T.I.P.S. certification for all workers, 3 Yea 0 Nay.
Tabled the one-day license application from Malden Chamber of Commerce until March 17, 2026, per applicant request.
Put on hold the Transfer of License for Alben Inc D.B.A Pearl Street Station, 53 Summer Street, until further notice, per the attorney's request.
plain_text:
CITY OF MALDEN
MASSACHUSETTS
Liquor Licensing Board
Meeting Minutes
Date: February 24, 2026
        Time: 6:00 PM
Members in Attendance :                           Also in Attendance:
Andy Zeiberg Gia Finocchiaro
Kevin Molis Cpt. Marc Gatcomb MPD
Denise Balboni-Cowie
Meeting Called to Order:  6:00 PM
Called to Order By: Andy Zeiberg
Seconded By: Kevin Molis
Approval of Minutes
 From: January 20, 2026
Approved By: Kevin Molis
Seconded By: Denise Cowie
The following were considered for approval:
1. The Licensing Board received an application for a One Day License for 
Malden Catholic located at 99 Crystal Street to be held on April 11, 2026, 
at 5:30PM to 10:30PM. Chris Jones and Julie Turner were present. Chris 
Jones the application explained to the board that the One Day License 
will be for as scholarship fundraiser in memory of this late brother who 
was a Malden Catholic Alumni as well as Chris Jones. The event is 21+, It
is a ticketed event. The tickets will need to be purchased in advance 
before the fundraiser. They will be serving Beer, Wine and Seltzers. A 
police detail will be hired. Food will be catered by a local Malden 
Business. They are expecting 150 to 175 people to attend. 175 is the max
number of tickets they will be selling. There will be 2 bartenders possibly 
a 3rd who all are T.I.P.S certified for the event. They are volunteers for the
event and each have at least 10+ years bartending experiences each. 
They will be taking out a liability insurance plan for the event per Malden 
Catholic’s requirements.
Motion to approve was made by Kevin Mollis, Seconded by Denise 
Cowie
3 Yea 0 Nay
2. The board reviewed a tabled application from last month’s meeting on 
January 20, 2026 from The Inkwell located at 75 Pleasant Street Suite 
200. Attorney Pat McDonald and Jason LoebGray Matter President were
present. The board reviewed the information that was presented last 
month and the new updated floor plans that was requested by the board 
last month. This site will not be a restaurant or package store. They are 
applying for a General On-Premises License. They are an immersive live 
theater experience. It is a pre-ticketed performance. No off-street 
customers are permitted to have an alcoholic beverage. They will only be 
serving alcoholic beverages after customers have experienced the live 
theater experiences. There will be 3 different experiences, each 
experience will be 8 people. They are expecting as genitive opening date 
of July 2026. Their experiences will be a 16+ no one younger will be 
permitted and each customer will need to sign a waiver and have an adult
present during the experience. No drop-off and pickups will be allowed. 
There will be cloud based cameras on site. Drinks served will be beer and
3 signature cocktails based off the experiences-No wine.
Motion to approve with conditions was made by Kevin Mollis, 
seconded by Denise Cowie; That a menu be provided to within 30 days 
and T.I.P.S. certification for all workers be sent to the board
3 Yea 0 Nay
3. An application for a 1 day license by Malden Chamber of Commerce was 
tabled until March 17, 2026 per the applicant request.
4. A Transfer of License for Alben Inc D.B.A Pearl Street Station located at 
53 Summer Street. The representing Attorney asked that the application 
be put on hold until further notice.
Meeting adjourned at :
Time: 6:53 PM
By: Andy Zeiberg
Motion By: Kevin Molis
Seconded By: Denise Balboni-Cowie
Minutes respectfully submitted by : Gia Finocchiaro – Liquor Licensing Clerk
